r2_test.question: Predict salary from years of experience and score the model on the test set. Return the test-set R squared, the fraction of test salary variance explained. Do not return the training score.
r2_test.reference:
r2_train = model.score(X_train, y_train)
r2_test = model.score(X_test, y_test)

cases.input: Test salaries predicted from years of experience.
cases.expect: The result is the test-set fraction of variance explained, not the training score.

cases.input: Predictions ignore years and miss the test salaries.
cases.expect: The test fraction is near zero.
